<div class="wp-block-group auto-content-wrapper is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<div class="wp-block-group is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<p class="has-text-align-center titulo-menu wp-block-paragraph"><a href="https://www.ballena-alegre.com/costabrava/en/the-resort/" data-type="page" data-id="6596">The Resort</a></p>
<div class="wp-block-columns is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-6c0a3a2d wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<p class="titulo wp-block-paragraph">All the facilities and services</p>
<p class="texto-menu wp-block-paragraph">Modern facilities and full services to enjoy maximum confort during the stay.</p>

        </a>

<div class="wp-block-columns is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-6c0a3a2d wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<p class="titulo wp-block-paragraph">Our commitment</p>
<p class="texto-menu wp-block-paragraph">We care for the environment with renewable energy, responsible management and respect for nature.</p>

<div class="wp-block-cover alignfull has-parallax bloque-sostenibilidad oh"><div class="wp-block-cover__image-background wp-image-7638 has-parallax" style="background-position:50% 50%;background-image:url(https://www.ballena-alegre.com/costabrava/wp-content/uploads/img-3197-scaled.jpg)"></div><span aria-hidden="true" class="wp-block-cover__background has-background-dim-20 has-background-dim"></span><div class="wp-block-cover__inner-container is-layout-flow wp-block-cover-is-layout-flow">
<div class="wp-block-columns titulo is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-6c0a3a2d wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<h2 class="wp-block-heading has-text-align-center has-theme-white-color has-text-color has-link-color wp-elements-cacc34a2e9fd45c17fa6824b40c92b69">Recognized as the most sustainable <br>campsite in Europe</h2>
</div>
</div>
<div class="wp-block-columns alignfull slider-texto-icono is-layout-flex wp-container-core-columns-is-layout-6c0a3a2d wp-block-columns-is-layout-flex">
<div class="wp-block-column has-animations is-layout-flow wp-block-column-is-layout-flow">
<div class="wp-block-slider animation--init--once animation--top">
    <div class="block-slider-splide splide" id="block_slide_3809">
        <div class="splide__track">
                <div class="acf-innerblocks-container">
<div class="wp-block-group premio is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<div class="wp-block-group is-layout-constrained wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained">
<p class="has-text-align-left titulo wp-block-paragraph"><strong><strong>ADAC</strong></strong></p>
<figure class="wp-block-image aligncenter size-full is-resized"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="225" height="225" src="https://www.ballena-alegre.com/costabrava/wp-content/uploads/adac-superplatz-2026.png"  class="wp-image-8417" style="width:105px;height:auto" srcset="https://www.ballena-alegre.com/costabrava/wp-content/uploads/adac-superplatz-2026.png 225w, https://www.ballena-alegre.com/costabrava/wp-content/uploads/adac-superplatz-2026-200x200.png 200w" sizes="auto, (max-width: 225px) 100vw, 225px" / alt="adac-superplatz-2026" title="adac-superplatz-2026"></figure>
</div>
<p class="has-text-align-left descripcion wp-block-paragraph">The title of ADAC-Superplatz with 5 stars is awarded by the ADAC (Allgemeiner Deutscher Automobil-Club) for quality and excellent services to the best campsites in Europe.</p>
</div>
<div class="wp-block-group premio is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<div class="wp-block-group is-layout-constrained wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained">
<p class="has-text-align-left titulo wp-block-paragraph"><strong>ANWB</strong></p>
<figure class="wp-block-image aligncenter size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="140" height="120" src="https://www.ballena-alegre.com/costabrava/wp-content/uploads/sostenibilidad-logo-anwb.jpg"  class="wp-image-4753"/ alt="sostenibilidad-logo-anwb" title="sostenibilidad-logo-anwb"></figure>
</div>
<p class="has-text-align-left descripcion wp-block-paragraph">The Royal Dutch Touring Club, known simply as ANWB, is an association of travellers in the Netherlands that supports all modes of travel.</p>
</div>
<div class="wp-block-group premio is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<div class="wp-block-group is-layout-constrained wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained">
<p class="has-text-align-left titulo wp-block-paragraph"><strong><strong>European Solar Award</strong></strong></p>
<figure class="wp-block-image aligncenter size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="140" height="120" src="https://www.ballena-alegre.com/costabrava/wp-content/uploads/sostenibilidad-logo-solarprize.jpg"  class="wp-image-4754"/ alt="sostenibilidad-logo-solarprize" title="sostenibilidad-logo-solarprize"></figure>
</div>
<p class="has-text-align-left descripcion wp-block-paragraph">The Bonn-based European Renewable Energy Association (EUROSOLAR) awards this prize to projects that stand out for their use of renewable energies. </p>
</div>
<div class="wp-block-group premio is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<div class="wp-block-group is-layout-constrained wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained">
<p class="has-text-align-left titulo wp-block-paragraph"><strong>TÜV – ISO</strong></p>
<figure class="wp-block-image aligncenter size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="140" height="120" src="https://www.ballena-alegre.com/costabrava/wp-content/uploads/sostenibilidad-logo-tuv.jpg"  class="wp-image-4756"/ alt="sostenibilidad-logo-tuv" title="sostenibilidad-logo-tuv"></figure>
</div>
<p class="has-text-align-left descripcion wp-block-paragraph">Certification granted by TÜV- Rheinland, guaranteeing compliance with ISO norms on international quality and environmental management standards. </p>
</div>
<div class="wp-block-group premio is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<div class="wp-block-group is-layout-constrained wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained">
<p class="has-text-align-left titulo wp-block-paragraph">DCC</p>
<figure class="wp-block-image aligncenter size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="140" height="120" src="https://www.ballena-alegre.com/costabrava/wp-content/uploads/sostenibilidad-logo-dcc.jpg"  class="wp-image-4757"/ alt="sostenibilidad-logo-dcc" title="sostenibilidad-logo-dcc"></figure>
</div>
<p class="has-text-align-left descripcion wp-block-paragraph">The DCC awards are presented by the Deutscher Camping Club (DCC) to campsites and resorts. The DCC is the leading association for campers in Germany. </p>
</div>
<div class="wp-block-group premio is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<div class="wp-block-group is-layout-constrained wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained">
<p class="has-text-align-left titulo wp-block-paragraph"><strong>EMAS</strong></p>
<figure class="wp-block-image aligncenter size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="140" height="120" src="https://www.ballena-alegre.com/costabrava/wp-content/uploads/sostenibilidad-logo-emas.jpg"  class="wp-image-4758"/ alt="sostenibilidad-logo-emas" title="sostenibilidad-logo-emas"></figure>
</div>
<p class="has-text-align-left descripcion wp-block-paragraph">EMAS (Eco Management and Audit Scheme) is a voluntary EU environmental management system. EMAS validation certifies compliance with environmental standards and the promotion of sustainable practices. </p>
</div>
<div class="wp-block-group premio is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<div class="wp-block-group is-layout-constrained wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained">
<p class="has-text-align-left titulo wp-block-paragraph"><strong>Camping of the year 2024</strong></p>
<figure class="wp-block-image aligncenter size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="140" height="120" src="https://www.ballena-alegre.com/costabrava/wp-content/uploads/sostenibilidad-logo-camping-2024.jpg"  class="wp-image-4759"/ alt="sostenibilidad-logo-camping-2024" title="sostenibilidad-logo-camping-2024"></figure>
</div>
<p class="has-text-align-left descripcion wp-block-paragraph">This award recognises the campsite as one of the best campsites of the year, based on criteria such as facilities, services, location and customer experience.</p>
</div>
<div class="wp-block-group premio is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<div class="wp-block-group is-layout-constrained wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained">
<p class="has-text-align-left titulo wp-block-paragraph"><strong>PIN Camp</strong></p>
<figure class="wp-block-image aligncenter size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="140" height="120" src="https://www.ballena-alegre.com/costabrava/wp-content/uploads/sostenibilidad-logo-pincamp.jpg"  class="wp-image-4760"/ alt="sostenibilidad-logo-pincamp" title="sostenibilidad-logo-pincamp"></figure>
</div>
<p class="has-text-align-left descripcion wp-block-paragraph">On ADAC&#8217;s online booking platform, the campsite has been ranked among the 25 best rated by campers in terms of service and quality. </p>
</div>
<div class="wp-block-group premio is-layout-flow wp-block-group-is-layout-flow">
<div class="wp-block-group is-layout-constrained wp-block-group-is-layout-constrained">
<p class="has-text-align-left titulo wp-block-paragraph"><strong><strong><strong><strong>Familiar tourism</strong></strong></strong></strong></p>
<figure class="wp-block-image aligncenter size-full"><img loading="lazy" decoding="async" width="140" height="120" src="https://www.ballena-alegre.com/costabrava/wp-content/uploads/sostenibilidad-logo-turisme-familiar.jpg"  class="wp-image-4762"/ alt="sostenibilidad-logo-turisme-familiar" title="sostenibilidad-logo-turisme-familiar"></figure>
</div>
<p class="has-text-align-left descripcion wp-block-paragraph">Catalonia awards a seal of quality to destinations and accommodation whose services and facilities are specially adapted for families.</p>
</div>
